# ReelLoom

> Local-first video-favorites-to-knowledge pipeline for Douyin and Bilibili,
> with browser-assisted AI analysis and Obsidian/Markdown output.

## What ReelLoom does

ReelLoom is an open-source Node.js CLI that helps users turn saved video items
into structured, searchable knowledge. It coordinates collectors, analyzers,
builders, checkpoints, and Markdown/Obsidian sinks while keeping the resulting
knowledge base on the user's machine.

## Verified scope

- A real 76-item Douyin-to-knowledge run produced usable structured output.
- Douyin collection, Doubao analysis, Markdown/Obsidian output, checkpoints,
  hierarchical classification, recovery tools, and CI tests are implemented.
- Bilibili support exists but has narrower verification coverage.
- YouTube and additional analyzers remain roadmap items unless STATUS.md says
  otherwise.

## Important boundaries

- ReelLoom is batch-oriented and does not guarantee word-for-word transcripts.
- It does not promise that third-party web services are free or unlimited.
- Users must comply with platform terms, quotas, privacy requirements, and
  content licenses. Automation stops for CAPTCHA and should be rate-limited.
- Original video files are not part of the generated knowledge base.
